intent.raw: Now that Body War has Craft, update the dispatch strategy to refine and validate all gaps and blockers, then use the model in projects/goldenquill/victor discovery to create a summary document for reasoning about what we will build and how it will be built.
intent.objective: Route Body War through Craft-ledger state, Refine gap/blocker closure, validation, and Victor-style discovery synthesis before implementation.
intent.operator_sentence: Use Craft as the state ledger, refine and validate gaps/blockers, and summarize the build model in a Victor-style discovery document.

route_menu.context_hint: Craft is now the local Body War state ledger; architecture/import-boundary decision is closed, while Strava evidence and track geometry remain visible open items.

items.description: Use Craft state, refine all blockers/gaps, validate the ledger, and synthesize a Victor-style summary before implementation.

items.description: Rejected because the summary must remain tied to Craft blockers, gaps, and validation gates.

technique_overlays.trigger: Body War now has a project-local Craft ledger.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Craft ledger remains the source of truth for blockers, gaps, open decisions, next moves, and recomposition state.

technique_overlays.trigger: Open Craft blockers and gaps must be refined before build planning.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each blocker/gap must be classified as close-now, decision-needed, defer, or reject, with closure evidence or residue.

technique_overlays.trigger: Operator requested the Victor discovery model for the reasoning summary.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Summary separates plain-language orientation, system shape, engineer verdicts, blockers, and build plan.

technique_overlays.trigger: Dispatch and summary evidence must not be mistaken for implementation readiness.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Implementation remains blocked unless architecture/import boundary and validation obligations are explicitly closed.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The route spans Craft state, Refine closure, DomainSpec architecture, Strava evidence, and Victor-style synthesis.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Use projected review lanes only after approval: Craft ledger reviewer, Refine blocker reviewer, DomainSpec architecture reviewer, Strava validation reviewer, and Victor-model summarizer. The parent dispatch owns synthesis.
context: Active blockers include architecture/import boundary and Strava activity submission.
Active gaps include Parque Taquaral geometry and DomainSpec method export/import selection.
Victor discovery model uses layered plain-language, system-shape, engineer-verdict, and ontology/ledger views.

roles.purpose: Verify Craft ledger state and recomposition status.
Refine each blocker/gap into closure evidence, decision need, deferral, or rejection.
Check TypeScript architecture/import boundary against DomainSpec methods.
Keep OAuth, activity import, and submission readiness claims separate.
Synthesize Body War into Victor-style discovery sections.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve projected review lanes to refine and validate all Body War Craft blockers/gaps before implementation?

validation: YAML parse passed before dispatch update.
native_stage_receipts.residue: Craft state is valid but implementation remains blocked.
native_stage_receipts.handoff_note: Use Craft ledger as the root state frame.

native_stage_receipts.residue: Summary is reasoning evidence, not build completion; Strava activity evidence remains blocked.
native_stage_receipts.handoff_note: Summary and architecture audit can feed the future implementation work-pack.

steps.name: X-ray Craft ledger state

capability_metadata.projection: Project-local Craft state ledger; not canonical Arcanum promotion.

stop_conditions: Stop if Craft ledger cannot parse or lacks blocker/gap/decision rows.
Stop if CRAFT.md is treated as source of truth instead of .craft/ledger.yml.

steps.name: Refine every active Craft blocker and gap
stop_conditions: Stop if any active blocker lacks a closure condition.
Stop if implementation is proposed before DEC-ARCH-BOUNDARY-001 is closed or explicitly deferred.

steps.name: Gate blocker-level architecture decisions

capability_metadata.projection: Used for blocker-level architecture choice if refine cannot safely close or defer it.

stop_conditions: Ask before closing a blocker-level architecture choice.
Block implementation if no architecture/import boundary is selected or explicitly deferred.

steps.name: Validate all gaps, blockers, and route evidence
stop_conditions: Block if any active blocker is marked closed without evidence.
Flag if any gap has no owner, treatment, or next route.

steps.name: Synthesize Victor-style discovery summary
stop_conditions: Do not mark the summary as build completion evidence.
Do not omit active blockers or deferred gaps from the summary.

steps.name: Prepare implementation-readiness handoff without executing it
stop_conditions: Return deferred if DEC-ARCH-BOUNDARY-001 remains open.
Do not start task-session implementation from this dispatch.

gates.condition: projects/body-war/.craft/ledger.yml is the state source of truth; CRAFT.md is only a human view.
Every active Craft blocker, blocking decision, and gap must be refined into closure evidence, decision need, deferral, or rejection.
DEC-ARCH-BOUNDARY-001 must be closed or explicitly deferred before implementation.
OAuth pass, activity import, and evidence submission must remain separate readiness claims.
The summary must separate plain-language orientation, system shape, engineer verdicts, blockers, gaps, and build route.
This dispatch updates strategy and summary artifacts only; no app implementation or deployment is authorized.
This route cannot promote Craft, DomainSpec, Inventory, Ontology, glossary, sigil, spell, or Body War readiness artifacts.

boundaries.contract: Craft ledger owns local state; generated summary and dispatch artifacts may reference it but do not replace it.
Refine may shape closure-ready artifacts and residue but does not close blocker-level decisions without decision-gate or operator approval.
Victor discovery structure may be used as a model; GoldenQuill product claims must not be copied into Body War.
Implementation requires a later explicit task-session after architecture/import boundary closure.

authority.lifecycle: Body War Craft and dispatch artifacts
authority.execution: none in this dispatch; future task-session only after gates pass
authority.validation: dispatch-spec validator plus future refine/decision-gate/task-session receipts
authority.evidence: Craft ledger, dispatch JSON, Victor-style Body War discovery summary
authority.promotion: none; summary and dispatch are reasoning artifacts

state_namespaces.write_policy: Craft state updates only; ledger remains source of truth.
Validated dispatch route artifacts and strategy specs.

state_namespaces.owner: Body War MVP reasoning and future architecture artifacts
state_namespaces.write_policy: Summary and audit docs only until implementation route is approved.
Read-only model reference; do not mutate from Body War route.

promotion_splits.rule: Craft state can identify blockers and next moves but cannot claim implementation readiness without closure evidence.
Structure may be reused; GoldenQuill product content must not be imported as Body War product claims.
Dispatch pass proves route shape only, not app readiness.

promotion_guardrails: Do not implement or deploy from this dispatch.
Do not treat Victor/GoldenQuill content as Body War content; use only the document model.
Do not close DEC-ARCH-BOUNDARY-001 without decision evidence.
Do not claim Strava readiness until real activity import and submission pass.
Do not promote Craft beyond project-local candidate ledger status.
